title: Inductive Backdoor Breadth Mapping: How Far Does Trigger Generalization Extend?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: map backdoor generalization radius -> determines whether trigger filtering is viable defense -> informs detection strategy. Directly actionable for defense design.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires fine-tuning an open-source model with a backdoor trigger, then systematic probing at varying semantic distances. Model fine-tuning and embedding-based distance computation add significant complexity for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Fine-tuning, systematic probing grid, embedding distance computation, boundary mapping. The fine-tuning alone could consume significant time. Compute-intensive for medium budget. Too broad for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
